listitem.para: UBL 2.5: Universal Business Language Version 2.5, OASIS Standard, https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.5/.
Global Test Data: safe example identifiers per country, https://sipico.github.io/global-test-data/.

ISO 3166-1: Codes for the representation of names of countries and their subdivisions — Part 1: Country code, including the user-assigned codes AA, QM–QZ, XA–XZ and ZZ, https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html.
ISO 4217: Codes for the representation of currencies; current list published by the maintenance agency, https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information/data-standards.html.
UN/EDIFACT 5153: Duty or tax or fee type name code, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trade/untdid/d16b/tred/tred5153.htm.
RFC 2606: Reserved Top Level DNS Names (the .example domain), https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2606.
ISO 13616: Financial services — International bank account number (IBAN), whose structure and check digits the world's account numbers follow.
